metadata.name: arena
metadata.description: ACME arena: escrow for live-race rooms and prize cups

accounts.name: mint
docs: Absent when `mint_key` is NATIVE_SOL.

accounts.name: claimer
docs: The winner (until `claim_until`), or anyone pushing it after.

accounts.name: entry
docs: Entries cups: the winner's entry (it must not have been refunded).

accounts.name: destination
docs: (SPL); checked when paid.

accounts.name: prize_vault_tokens
docs: what the cup owed (needed only when there are some); checked when paid.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable: closing a transfer-fee token's escrow harvests its withheld fees into the mint.

accounts.name: prize_vault_tokens
docs: tokens left in the escrow (needed only when there are some); checked when paid.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable: closing a transfer-fee token's escrow harvests its withheld fees into the mint.

accounts.name: organizer
docs: Organizer and sponsor: pays the guarantee (if any).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the cup's rent (the organizer, or the house keeper).

accounts.name: host
docs: An admin-approved host's record (the path with no token).

accounts.name: holder_tokens
docs: A token-holding host's project-token account.

accounts.name: escrow_tokens
docs: The cup's associated token account; create it earlier in the transaction.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Stakes, and takes the first seat.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the room's rent (the race server's sponsor, or the creator); it gets
it back when the room closes.

accounts.name: upgrades
docs: house program (may not exist yet: stock). Checked in the handler.

accounts.name: holder_tokens
docs: The creator's project-token account, to claim the holder fee for the room.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Token rooms only (all four absent for SOL). The escrow is the room's
associated token account; create it (idempotently) earlier in the same
transaction.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the entry's rent (the race server's sponsor, or the player).

accounts.name: program
docs: The program itself, used to reach its ProgramData record.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Only the upgrade authority may bootstrap the protocol. Without this the
first caller after deploy would become admin and pick the treasury.

accounts.name: player_tokens
docs: Token rooms: where the stake goes back to (owned by the player).

types.name: AllowedMint
docs: A token allowed for rooms and cups, with its limits and fees.
PDA `["mint", mint]`. SOL itself is `mint = NATIVE_SOL`.

fields.name: token_program
docs: Owner program of the mint (Token or Token-2022); System Program for SOL.

fields.name: room_fee_bps
docs: House fee on a room's pot in this token, and on a cup's entries.

fields.name: transfer_fee
docs: The mint carries a transfer fee (the project token): deposits are grossed
up and new deposits stop if its fee goes above `max_transfer_fee_bps`.

fields.name: holder_max_stake
docs: The holder fee applies only to rooms staking at most this much (renting a
balance to dodge fees must cost more than it saves).

types.name: Config
docs: Protocol settings. One per deployment, PDA `["config"]`.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin transfer: `propose_admin` sets this, the new key accepts.
`Pubkey::default()` = nothing pending.

fields.name: guardian
docs: Emergency key: may pause, reject posted cup results, cancel cups and revoke
every resolver. Never moves money anywhere except back to its owners.

fields.name: gate
docs: Co-signs every new room, join and cup entry (ping, region, age, invite
checks off-chain). `Pubkey::default()` = ungated. It can only admit money;
it can never block an exit.

fields.name: resolvers
docs: Keys that lock, settle and void rooms and post cup results (the race
server). Checked against the CURRENT set when used, so rotating a key never
strands a room in flight.

fields.name: treasury
docs: The house treasury PDA: every fee goes here (its token accounts for SPL).

fields.name: prize_vault
docs: The house prize-vault PDA: escrow surpluses go here, and it may organize
funded cups (the house program signs for it).

fields.name: holder_mint
docs: Holder perks: the project token, set once (`Pubkey::default()` = none yet).

fields.name: holder_min
docs: A room created by a wallet holding at least this many base units of
`holder_mint` gets `holder_room_fee_bps` (if lower than its mint's fee).

fields.name: host_min
docs: A wallet holding at least this many may organize community cups.

fields.name: settle_window_secs
docs: A locked room must be settled or voided within this; after it anyone
refunds every stake, no fee.

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops new rooms, joins, cups and entries. Never stops settling, refunds,
claims or closing.

fields.name: cup_count
docs: Cups made so far (a counter: a cup's id is its creator's choice).

fields.name: pending_guardian
docs: A new guardian, gate and resolver set, in force from `roles_after`
(`ROLES_TIMELOCK_SECS` after it was proposed; 0 = nothing pending).

types.name: Cup
docs: A prize event: a leaderboard over a window, an optional entry fee, a payout
table, an optional guarantee and an optional featured stock.
PDA `["cup", id_le]`; escrow is the PDA (SOL) or its ATA.

fields.name: sponsor
docs: Paid the guarantee; gets back what isn't won.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the cup's rent (the organizer, or the house keeper); gets it back.

fields.name: host
docs: A community cup's host (`Pubkey::default()` = none) and its share of the
house fee, paid at close.

fields.name: spec_hash
docs: sha256 of the event's race spec, published with it.

fields.name: featured_mint
docs: The event's featured stock: winners may swap their prize into it in their
own claim transaction. Informational: the program never holds it.

fields.name: prize_vault
docs: Anything left above what the cup owed goes here at close.

fields.name: max_transfer_fee_bps
docs: New entries stop if the token's transfer fee goes above this.

fields.name: payout_bps
docs: Share of the pool per place, in bps, summing to 10000.

fields.name: guarantee
docs: Minimum pool, deposited by `sponsor` at creation.

fields.name: results_deadline
docs: Results must be posted before this, or every entry can be refunded.

fields.name: max_entrants
docs: 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: results_root
docs: Merkle root over leaves hash(0x00 ‖ cup ‖ rank_le16 ‖ wallet) for every
paid place. Ranks only: the program computes every amount.

fields.name: standings_hash
docs: Hash of the full published standings (every ranked run and its record).

fields.name: claim_until
docs: Before this only the winner may claim (and swap into the featured stock);
after it anyone may push the prize to the winner.

fields.name: pool
docs: Set by `finalize`.

fields.name: claimed
docs: Bit r-1 set = rank r paid.

fields.name: featured_mint
docs: The event's featured stock (`Pubkey::default()` = none).

fields.name: host_share_bps
docs: Community cups only: the host's share of the house fee.

types.name: Entry
docs: One player's cup entry. PDA `["entry", cup, player]`.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the entry's rent (the race server's sponsor, or the player); gets it back.

types.name: Host
docs: A wallet the admin lets organize community cups (the path with no token).
PDA `["host", wallet]`.

fields.name: until
docs: Hosting allowed until this unix time.

fields.name: allow_transfer_fee
docs: Accept a transfer-fee mint (the project token), up to this fee per transfer.

fields.name: pushed
docs: The winner signed (and may have swapped it into the featured stock), or
it was pushed after the claim window.

types.name: RaceSpec
docs: What race a room runs: the race server builds exactly this race.

fields.name: format
docs: 0 sprint, 1 grand prix.

fields.name: ai
docs: AI cars on the grid.

fields.name: time
docs: 0 day, 1 sunset, 2 night.

fields.name: sky
docs: 0 clear, 1 cloudy, 2 light, 3 rain, 4 storm, 5 changing.

fields.name: start_mode
docs: 0 starts when full, 1 the creator starts it (two players or more).

types.name: Room
docs: A live race's pot: everyone stakes the same, the race server runs the race,
the resolver settles it and the program pays the fastest at once.
PDA `["room", code]`, where `code` is the race server's 8-character room id.
The escrow is the PDA itself (SOL) or its associated token account.
The first fields form a fixed prefix after the 8-byte discriminator, so the
lobby can filter with memcmp: state @8, access @9, class @10, mint @11,
stake @43, max_players @51, max_rating @52.

fields.name: max_rating
docs: GARAGE rooms: the highest car rating allowed, in tenths; 0 = no cap.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Terms frozen at creation: config changes never touch a room in flight.

fields.name: max_transfer_fee_bps
docs: New stakes stop if the token's transfer fee goes above this.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the room's rent (the server's sponsor, or the creator); gets it back.

fields.name: players
docs: Seat order = the race's grid order.

fields.name: levels
docs: GARAGE rooms: each player's upgrade levels when they joined.

fields.name: seed
docs: Drawn after the room locks (`draw_seed`): hash(room ‖ the hash of the slot
it locked in ‖ that slot). All zeros until then.

fields.name: times_ms
docs: Final times in seat order, set at settlement. `DNF` = no result.

fields.name: winners
docs: Bit i set = players[i] was paid a winner's share.

fields.name: record_hash
docs: sha256 of the race's full record (canonical JSON), published by the race
server: anyone can run the race again from it and check these times.

fields.name: locked_slot
docs: The slot the room locked in: its hash, unknown while the locking
transaction ran, is the seed's source.

fields.name: settle_deadline
docs: After this (locked), anyone can refund every stake, no fee.

fields.name: surplus
docs: Anything above what the room owed (a donation, a reward pushed to the
escrow), sent to the prize vault.

fields.name: locked_slot
docs: The seed comes from this slot's hash, once it is over (`draw_seed`).

fields.name: max_rating
docs: GARAGE only: the highest rating allowed, in tenths (0 = no cap).

fields.name: share
docs: What each winner was sent from escrow (before any transfer fee).

types.name: Ruleset
docs: One version of the game's rules (physics, track, race rules, upgrade
effects), hashed by the game build. Rooms and cups name the ruleset they are
raced under, so a new sim version can never re-rule a race in flight.
PDA `["ruleset", id_le]`.

fields.name: rating_points
docs: A GARAGE car's rating points per department level (`src/game/upgrades.js`
order: pu, aero, tyre, brake, chassis, dur), in tenths of a rating point.

types.name: WindowParams
docs: The windows the admin may change at once (they only reach FUTURE rooms and
cups, which freeze their own).
